title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with Alnajjar Firm — a creative media and marketing agency in Lebanon.

faq.q: What does a media agency do?
faq.a: A media agency like Alnajjar Firm specializes in creating, managing, and distributing content to grow your brand online. We handle everything from social media management and content creation to video production, reels, graphic design, branding, and digital marketing strategy — so your business gets seen by the right audience.

faq.q: Why should a business hire a social media agency in Lebanon?
faq.a: Lebanon's digital market is highly competitive. Hiring a specialized social media agency in Lebanon like Alnajjar Firm gives you access to a local team that understands the Lebanese audience, culture, and business landscape. We create content tailored to your market and manage your platforms strategically to drive real results.

faq.q: How much does content creation cost in Lebanon?
faq.a: Content creation pricing in Lebanon varies based on scope, volume, and the type of content needed. Alnajjar Firm offers customized packages that include video production, reels, photography, and social media management. Contact us directly for a tailored quote based on your specific goals.

faq.q: Do you create Instagram Reels and TikTok videos?
faq.a: Yes. Reels and short-form video production is one of our core specialties. Our shooting and editing team produces professional, platform-optimized content for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and YouTube — scripted, shot, and edited to maximize reach and engagement.

faq.q: Do you offer branding and graphic design services?
faq.a: Yes. We offer full branding services including logo design, brand identity, visual guidelines, and graphic design. Our creative team develops brand identities that are professional, consistent, and built to stand out across all digital and print formats.

faq.q: Can you manage our social media pages?
faq.a: Absolutely. Social media management is a core service at Alnajjar Firm. We handle content planning, posting schedules, captions, hashtag strategy, community engagement, and performance tracking across Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, and LinkedIn.

faq.q: Do you provide video editing services?
faq.a: Yes. Our dedicated editing team provides professional video editing for reels, long-form content, brand videos, testimonials, and more. We handle color grading, sound design, subtitles, and motion graphics to produce polished, high-quality results.

faq.q: Do you work with businesses outside Lebanon?
faq.a: Yes. While we are based in Awkar, Lebanon, we work with clients across the Middle East including UAE, Saudi Arabia, and beyond. Our remote production capabilities allow us to deliver content and manage social media for clients anywhere in the world.
